evaluation_benchmarks.question: Why did our profits decline in North India in August 2024?
key_evidence: Chiller compressor breakdown at Delhi Central Distribution Centre (WH-DEL-01) from Aug 11-16 causing ₹2.68M dairy/poultry write-offs.
Monsoon flooding on routes RT-DEL-CHD and RT-DEL-JAI causing 18-38 hour delays.
Cold chain breaches on vehicles reaching 14-19.8°C causing transit spoilage of ₹1.19M.
Emergency logistics costs inflated by ₹1.85M due to detours, idle reefer diesel, and driver overtime.

evaluation_benchmarks.question: Which month had the worst sales in North India during 2024, and what factors explain it?
key_evidence: August 2024 recorded the lowest gross revenue (₹1.85 Cr vs average ₹2.2 Cr).
Stockouts of fresh dairy following warehouse chiller compressor failure.
Customer order cancellations due to severe highway delivery delays during peak monsoon.

evaluation_benchmarks.question: Did weather conditions affect deliveries or spoilage in North India in August 2024?
key_evidence: Heavy monsoon rainfall recorded across Delhi, Chandigarh, and Jaipur between Aug 5 and Aug 24.
Precipitation coincided with highway transit delays and reefer compressor fuel exhaustion.
Important caveat: Weather was a major contributing factor to transport delays, but warehouse compressor mechanical failure accounted for the majority of spoilage.

evaluation_benchmarks.question: Which routes are causing the highest transportation costs per kilometer?
key_evidence: RT-DEL-SXR (Delhi to Srinagar) is the most expensive route at ₹71.86/km with 24 cold chain breaches.
RT-DEL-JAI (Delhi to Jaipur) had the highest delays (1.02 hrs avg, up to 36 hrs in August) at ₹46.64/km.

evaluation_benchmarks.question: Which product saw volume growth but a drop in profit margins in 2024?
key_evidence: Fresh Organic Paneer 500g sales volume expanded by ~40% due to promotional 20% discount.
Raw milk supplier procurement prices rose by 18%, causing gross margin compression from ~28% to ~8.5%.

evaluation_benchmarks.question: Calculate the estimated financial loss for North India in August 2024 and suggest next steps.
recommended_actions: Implement N+1 dual compressor redundancy at Delhi Central DC.
Deploy IoT live temperature telematics with cellular alerts on reefer trucks.
Establish buffer stock partnerships in Chandigarh and Jaipur for monsoon months.
Re-negotiate carrier SLAs to include temperature breach liability.
